title: CERN 超級質子同步加速器
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以 SPS 的 744 台常溫偶極磁鐵與 Bρ = 3.3356·p 為起點，理解它如何把 26 GeV/c 質子加速到 450 GeV/c，再把 200 MHz 行波腔與固態放大器、非晶碳鍍膜、線掃描器發射度量測、三階共振慢引出損失預算與向 LHC 轉移的機器保護整合成可驗收的注入器工程。
summaryEn: Starting from the SPS's 744 warm dipoles and Bρ = 3.3356·p, see how it takes protons from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c, then integrate 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities with solid-state amplifiers, amorphous-carbon coating, wire-scanner emittance measurement, the third-integer slow-extraction loss budget and LHC-transfer machine protection into an acceptable injector engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」與「射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV" and "RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “744 main dipole magnets” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “744 main dipole magnets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “744 main dipole magnets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強
knowledge.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV
knowledge.text: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。
knowledge.textEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c].

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV" is correct?
options: SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。
轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。
optionsEn: The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets.
Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.
quiz.explanation: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “744 main dipole magnets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。
knowledge.textEn: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV", which statement holds?
options: 只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。
optionsEn: If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m.
quiz.explanation: 744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「744 台主偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “744 main dipole magnets” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。
knowledge.textEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV"?
options: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
optionsEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
quiz.explanation: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “744 main dipole magnets” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
knowledge.textEn: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。

If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.
Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「200 MHz 行波加速腔」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Longitudinal stability depends on the slip factor η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²: above transition, higher-momentum particles take longer per turn. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz；h = 4620 時 f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz，桶距 5 ns。26 GeV/c 時 γ = 27.73：Q26（γt = 22.8）η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴；Q20（γt = 18）η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³，約大 2.9 倍。縱向不穩定門檻隨 |η| 上升，因此在相同阻抗下 Q20 可承受更高的束團強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart. At 26 GeV/c, γ = 27.73: for Q26 (γt = 22.8), η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴; for Q20 (γt = 18), η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³, about 2.9 times larger. Longitudinal instability thresholds rise with |η|, so Q20 tolerates higher bunch intensity for the same impedance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz; with h = 4620, f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz and buckets are 5 ns apart. At 26 GeV/c, γ = 27.73: for Q26 (γt = 22.8), η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴; for Q20 (γt = 18), η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³, about 2.9 times larger. steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「200 MHz 行波加速腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.

Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow.
quiz.explanation: 以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
